design: hsm_shell.sv of the chip's RTL root, TRUSTEDGE_REVC on, ENABLE_MLKEM_K_CHANNEL on, EXTERNAL_HMAC on (HMAC outputs are free inputs)

properties.P1: no bit of K reaches the host: two copies that differ only in K give identical responses
properties.P2: a sealed frame's counter is exactly the previous one plus one, starting at 1
properties.P3: an accepted frame carries the epoch of the current binding and a counter above the last accepted
properties.P4: after the rejection limit no frame is accepted until the next binding or zeroisation
properties.P5: a binding is refused as a replay only if an earlier successful command used that counter or a later one
properties.P6: a binding succeeds only with a nonce ready, returns that nonce as its epoch and consumes it

props_cover.checks: reachability of a binding, a sealed frame, a received frame and the lock

miter_bmc.checks: P1, two copies differing only in K, bounded
